name: 244. Responses output is always an array (responses output array)
description:
output is a required array on every Responses object. Claude streams on /v1/responses (Bedrock Converse, Bedrock InvokeModel, Anthropic) built response.created and response.in_progress with no items, and response.completed with none when the turn came back empty, and the native route serialized that as "output": null. /openai normalized it through WithDefaults; /v1 did not.

Claude returns empty turns (content [], end_turn), typically right after a tool result in an agent loop. pydantic-ai iterates response.output on terminal events, so a customer streaming gpt-6-sol with a Bedrock Haiku fallback crashed with TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable whenever the fallback served an empty turn. BifrostResponsesResponse.MarshalJSON now sends [] for a nil output.

Each case forces an empty turn with an assistant prefill and asserts every lifecycle event carries an array. Red before the fix on every run (response.created was always null). The fallback case uses a nonexistent primary so the Bedrock fallback serves the stream, the customer's path.

item.name: bedrock/us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 /v1/responses stream empty turn: responses output array on every lifecycle event

body.raw: {"model":"bedrock/us.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0","stream":true,"max_output_tokens":64,"input":[{"type":"message","role":"user","content":"Reply with exactly the word OK and nothing else."},{"type":"message","role":"assistant","content":"OK"}]}

exec: var events = txt.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data:') === 0; }).map(function (l) { return l.slice(5).trim(); }).filter(function (d) { return d && d !== '[DONE]'; }).map(function (d) { try { return JSON.parse(d); } catch (e) { return { unparsed: d }; } });
var lifecycle = events.filter(function (e) { return e.response && typeof e.response === 'object'; });
pm.test('responses output array bedrock: created, in_progress and completed all streamed', function () {
pm.test('responses output array bedrock: every lifecycle event carries response.output as an array, never null', function () {
pm.expect(Array.isArray(e.response.output), e.type + ' response.output = ' + JSON.stringify(e.response.output) + ' (required array; pydantic-ai iterates it)').to.be.true;
